version.readonlyNotice: Read-only (deprecated): cannot release, switch live, load or delete
version.pointerNotice: "Switch live" only moves the live pointer and leaves the draft untouched; "Load into draft" only rewrites the draft and leaves the live version running.
version.privateTip: Private skills have no version of their own: their version is the owning agent's version, frozen when that agent is released
version.badgeTipUnreleased: No official version yet: production calls are rejected; only the editor's debug run works
version.badgeTipDirty: Live is running v{v}; the draft has unreleased changes
version.statusUnreleased: No official release yet: production entry points (MCP / RPC / endpoint / call) will fail
version.statusDirty: Current version v{v}: the draft has unreleased changes, live is still v{v}
version.statusClean: Current version v{v}: matches the draft
version.rollbackConfirm:
Production switches to v{v} immediately: formal calls (MCP / RPC / endpoint / agent) follow this version right away. The draft is untouched.

Call permissions and skill bindings are not rolled back (they always reflect the current configuration) — who can call it stays exactly as before the rollback.
version.applyConfirm:
Load the contents of v{v} back into the draft? Live keeps running the current version until you release again.

Call permissions and skill bindings are not written back; the agent's "Unrestricted tools / Skill discovery" switches are part of the definition and are written back from this version.
version.deleteConfirm: The history record of v{v} will be deleted permanently. The live version and the draft are unaffected.
